title: Add Submit Button to Booking Form

requirements.text: Add a submit button to the BookingSection component that triggers form submission when clicked
acceptanceCriteria: A visible submit button is present in the BookingSection form
The button triggers the existing handleSubmit function when clicked
The button is appropriately styled and labeled (e.g., 'Submit Booking' or 'Book Now')
The button is disabled during form submission to prevent duplicate submissions

constraints: Do not modify the existing booking form structure or fields
Use the existing handleSubmit logic already present in BookingSection.tsx
Maintain consistency with the current UI design patterns
